zu01-01.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
zu01-01.draft: Igquma linyakaza ngamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukungaboni lutho.

zu01-02.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
zu01-02.draft: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka igaraji likaphethiloli. Akukho okwenzekayo.

zu01-03.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
zu01-03.draft: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMsombuluko uqala kancane.

zu01-04.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.

zu01-05.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
zu01-05.draft: Umoya omncane uthutha i-jacaranda iye komunye umgwaqo, imbali ngembali. I-stoep iyavuma.

zu01-06.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
zu01-06.draft: Ngu-6 ekuseni kanti ifriji isivele iyindawo ethandwa kakhulu endlini.

zu01-07.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
zu01-07.draft: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi, njengenjwayelo, azenzi.

zu01-08.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
zu01-08.draft: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukushisa akuvulwanga.

zu01-09.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
zu01-09.draft: Izingubo bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule. Umoya omncane uvote ukuthi zisale.

zu01-10.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
zu01-10.draft: Izingubo zizobe zomile ngaphambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncane uqale umsebenzi kusenesikhathi.

zu01-11.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
zu01-11.draft: Isandla ekepisini, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Umoya omncane uhamba naye.

zu01-12.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
zu01-12.draft: Isimo sezulu esihle sokuhlangana nomuntu 'obekumele umshayele ucingo'.

zu01-13.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
zu01-13.draft: Inyanga ivakashela phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama isezulwini.

zu01-14.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
zu01-14.draft: Amafu anike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibili. Akekho otshele umswakama.

zu01-15.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
zu01-15.draft: Umoya omncane usafudumele ngalesi sikhathi. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

zu01-16.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
zu01-16.draft: Ifu phezu kwentaba, i-potjie ngaphansi kwe-lapa. Kokubili kusadinga elinye ihora.

zu01-17.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
zu01-17.draft: I-bushveld ise-silent mode namuhla. Wonke umuntu. Yonke into.

zu01-18.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
zu01-18.draft: Idolobha Elinobungane alikaze licele ukuba yiDolobha Elinomoya, kodwa noma kunjalo.

zu01-19.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
zu01-19.draft: Amafu ntambama yonke, akukho ngisho nethonsi. Ipayipi lamanzi libuyele emsebenzini.

zu01-20.en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.
zu01-20.draft: Kusasa yingxoxo entsha nesimo sezulu. Kulobu busuku siyaphumula.

zu01-21.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
zu01-21.draft: Azikho izithunzi, akukho ukukhazimula, azikho izaba. UMsombuluko ungaphansi kwesivalo se-Tupperware.

zu01-22.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.

zu01-23.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
zu01-23.draft: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.

zu02-01.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
zu02-01.draft: Izicathulo emakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.

zu02-02.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
zu02-02.draft: Hamba manje noma ungahambi nhlobo. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngu-7.

zu02-03.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
zu02-03.draft: Ngikhohlwe ukuvula ingubo kagesi kusenesikhathi. Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.

zu02-04.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
zu02-04.draft: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nommbila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.

zu02-05.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
zu02-05.draft: Amafu ambalwa eze ukuzobuka. Nawo awagijimi.

zu02-06.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
zu02-06.draft: Ilanga lishona kancane, lizibukisa ngempela. Kodwa liyakufanele.

zu02-07.en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.
zu02-07.draft: Kusihlwa kufika ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.

zu02-08.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
zu02-08.draft: Amafu adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye. I-balcony iyajabula ukulinda.

zu02-09.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
zu02-09.draft: Ifulegi lasekhoneni likhomba ngqo lapho ibhola lizophambukela khona.

zu02-10.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.

zu02-11.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
zu02-11.draft: Ngisho nezimpala zimi emthunzini zicabanga kabusha ngezinqumo zazo.

zu02-12.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
zu02-12.draft: Impompi yomoya yenza umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayikhuthaza nje.

zu02-13.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
zu02-13.draft: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.

zu02-14.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
zu02-14.draft: Isibhakabhaka sisuke empunga ekhanyayo saya empunga emnyama. Yilowo wonke umbukiso.

zu02-15.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
zu02-15.draft: Ifasitela ngalinye elikhanyayo ngumuntu onquma ukuthi: kwanele namuhla.

zu02-16.en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.

zu02-17.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
zu02-17.draft: Umthunzi uhamba emigqeni, owodwa ngowodwa. Uyahlola.

zu02-18.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
zu02-18.draft: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wefu, umgqomo ugcwele. NguLwesibili ebusuku, njengoba kumenyezelwe.

zu02-19.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
zu02-19.draft: Ilanga ngeke lize lizohlola ukukhazimula namuhla. Imoto ayinankinga ngalokho.

zu02-20.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
zu02-20.draft: Ngisho ne-hadeda ithule. Isibhakabhaka yisona esibeke isimo.

zu02-21.en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.

zu02-22.en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.
zu02-22.draft: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusicula ukuze silale, mahhala.

zu02-23.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
zu02-23.draft: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyona yodwa enesitayela sezinwele esenzelwe wona.

zu03-01.en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.
zu03-01.draft: Ingubo eyodwa, abantu ababili, amahloni awekho.

zu03-02.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
zu03-02.draft: Uthuli lukhazimula njengegolide ekukhanyeni kokushona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.

zu03-03.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
zu03-03.draft: Ithafa lonke linombala owehlisiwe. Inani lezimvu liyafana noma kunjani.

zu03-04.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
zu03-04.draft: Intuthu ifike egcekeni labomakhelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo manje ingumcimbi womphakathi ngokusemthethweni.

zu03-05.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
zu03-05.draft: Amafu ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMsombuluko ubukweleta wonke umuntu lokho.

zu03-06.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
zu03-06.draft: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Gqoka izingubo ezifudumele ukubuka umbukiso.

zu03-07.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
zu03-07.draft: Ngisho nalabo abafunga ukuthi akuze kubande bayavuma manje.

zu03-08.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
zu03-08.draft: Indwangu yetafula yentaba igqokwe uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.

zu03-09.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
zu03-09.draft: Izinwele zakhe zifike kuqala esitolo sesinkwa. Umoya omncane unezinhlelo zawo zangeSonto.

zu03-10.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.

zu03-12.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
zu03-12.draft: Isihlabathi siwela umgwaqo inhlamvu ngenhlamvu. Akekho lapha ojahile.

zu03-13.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
zu03-13.draft: Inyanga ingemuva kwefu, inja iku-stoep. Inkonzo yangeSonto iphelile.

zu03-14.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
zu03-14.draft: Ilanga, bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela ngalokho.

zu03-15.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
zu03-15.draft: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kumpunga ngokufanayo. Izibani zasesikhumulweni kuphela ezizamile.

zu03-16.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
zu03-16.draft: Ilanga seliphumile emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, ne-balcony nayo.

zu03-17.held: not applied: the slot already holds a line

zu03-18.en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
zu03-18.draft: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.

zu03-19.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
zu03-19.draft: Isivunguvungu esincane sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Futhi asizihluphi ngokushova.

zu03-20.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
zu03-20.draft: Othile ukhohliwe izingubo. Umoya omncane wona awukhohlwanga, futhi wenza umsebenzi omuhle.

zu03-21.en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.
zu03-21.draft: Amatshe azokwaba ukushisa kwanamuhla ubusuku bonke. Mahhala.

zu03-22.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
zu03-22.draft: Izibuko zelanga ziyagqokwa, ziyakhunyulwa, ziyagqokwa. ULwesihlanu ntambama kungukuzivocavoca.

zu03-23.en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.

zu04-01.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.
zu04-01.draft: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.

zu04-02.en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
zu04-02.draft: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kuphela ukuthula.

zu04-03.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
zu04-03.draft: Isimo sezulu se-trout. Kumnandi ezinhlanzini. Kuyakha isimilo somdobi.

zu04-04.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.

zu04-05.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
zu04-05.draft: Impompi yomoya ayikholelwa esikhathini sokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa kuso.

zu04-06.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
zu04-06.draft: Asikhulumi nganamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya ngathi.

zu04-07.en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
zu04-07.draft: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo ekuseni. Ukulinda bekukufanele.

zu04-08.en: The 7am sun isn't giving heat yet. Only vibes.
zu04-08.draft: Ilanga lango-7 ekuseni alikakhiphi ukushisa. Yi-vibe nje.

zu04-09.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
zu04-09.draft: Isibani sezokuphepha sikhanyise kusenesikhathi. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kahle.

zu04-10.en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.

zu04-11.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
zu04-11.draft: Ulwandle luyi-12 degrees. Ngo-10 kuzozwakala njenge-spa.

zu04-12.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
zu04-12.draft: Amafulegi aqonde ngqo, iwayini libanjwe ngokuqinile. Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo uMsombuluko ozolile.

zu04-13.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
zu04-13.draft: Amafu okushona kwelanga, amanzi okunisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizilungiselela imvula yalo.

zu04-14.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
zu04-14.draft: Izithunzi zamafu zihamba kancane ziwela inkundla. Akekho okhalazayo.

zu04-15.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
zu04-15.draft: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.

zu04-16.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
zu04-16.draft: Intaba izembese ingubo ekhanda. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.

zu04-17.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
zu04-17.draft: IJeffreys Bay: lapho umoya uzilolongela khona ngaphambi kweshifu yawo eKapa.

zu04-18.en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
zu04-18.draft: Amanzi okunisela kuthiwa awotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abemi emanzini.

zu04-19.en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.
zu04-19.draft: Lonke idolobha libe nesu elifanayo kulobu busuku. Bheka thina sonke.

zu04-20.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
zu04-20.draft: Ama-blesbok awagqoki zikhafu futhi awakhali. Singafunda okuthile. Ngeke, kodwa singafunda.

zu04-21.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
zu04-21.draft: Yisikhathi sekhefu, futhi umoya omncane ulungisa izinwele zabo bonke. Nothisha.

zu04-22.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
zu04-22.draft: Inyanga ikhanya kancane kulobu busuku. Isibani sezokuphepha asinalo lelo khono.

zu04-23.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
zu04-23.draft: Isibhakabhaka sithulile, nolayini uthulile. UMsombuluko awukayitholi ivolumu.

zu05-01.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
zu05-01.draft: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zizibambele.

zu05-02.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
zu05-02.draft: Umoya omncane uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo. Wonke umgwaqo uyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.

zu05-03.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
zu05-03.draft: Okunsomi phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.

zu05-04.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
zu05-04.draft: Amaqabunga ahlala ekhanyisa isibani sezokuphepha. Inja ayisasukumi ngenxa yawo.

zu05-05.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
zu05-05.draft: Amashidi asomile kakade. Manje umoya omncane uziqhayisa nje enganeni.

zu05-06.en: Somebody's mom is going to have words. Worth it.
zu05-06.draft: Umama womuntu othile uzothethisa. Kodwa bekumnandi.

zu05-07.en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
zu05-07.draft: IKapa ngemuva kwe-front: licwebile, liyakhanya, futhi liyabanda impela.

zu05-08.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
zu05-08.draft: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi, kancane nje.

zu05-09.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
zu05-09.draft: Umoya wenza wonke umsebenzi. I-kite ithatha lonke udumo.

zu05-10.held: not applied: the slot already holds a line

zu05-11.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
zu05-11.draft: Amafu aphenduke abe yi-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.

zu05-12.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
zu05-12.draft: Isibani esibayeni yikho ukushona kwelanga kulobu busuku. Izinkomo ziyakwamukela ukwehliswa.

zu05-13.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
zu05-13.draft: Ifulegi linikeza isibikezelo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: hambani.

zu05-14.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
zu05-14.draft: Umoya omncane usebenza etafuleni lezithelo namuhla. I-air-con ifakiwe, ayikho imali eyengeziwe.

zu05-16.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
zu05-16.draft: Kubanda impela namuhla. Uhlobo olungena emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.

zu05-17.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

zu05-18.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
zu05-18.draft: Indwangu yetafula ilungisiwe, ilungele umsebenzi wakusasa.

zu05-19.en: The South-Easter has no off switch. We've looked.

zu05-20.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
zu05-20.draft: Ifu elilodwa phezu kwentaba alisona isimo sezulu. Umlilo uqhubeka uvutha.

zu05-21.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
zu05-21.draft: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle kuvumelene ngombala ekuseni. Akuwona umbala ojabulisayo.

zu05-22.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
zu05-22.draft: Inja ithole umngcele ngqo phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ihlala khona.

zu05-23.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
zu05-23.draft: Izinkomo sezisekhaya ngaphambi kokuba umbala uphele. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.

zu05-24.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
zu05-24.draft: Isibhakabhaka esimpunga, amajezi agqokiwe, isikole siphumile. Impelasonto ayidingi imvume yelanga.
